children: VitaNova Life Sciences Corp reported first-quarter 2027 results (three months ended July 31, 2026) with revenue of $321.6K, a 210% increase from the year-ago quarter, while the company recorded a net loss of $123.1K and a basic and diluted loss per share of $(0.01).
Revenue: $321.6K for Q1 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up from $103.9K in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 209.6%.
Net income: Net loss $123.1K for Q1 2027, compared with a net loss of $46.3K in the year‑ago quarter (larger loss YoY).
Diluted EPS: Basic and diluted loss per share $(0.01) for Q1 2027, same as $(0.01) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue growth was driven by a new healthy food product line; the company expanded beyond supplements into food products such as olive juice, sesame oil and aloe vera.
The new food line gained rapid traction, accounting for 91% of Q1 revenue and concentrated among three major customers.
Operational steps to scale the business included establishing VGFC on March 6, 2026 and WQC on June 17, 2026 to support food production and raw material supply.
The shift toward lower‑margin food products reduced gross margin to 9% from 66% year over year, reflecting promotional pricing to build the new channel.
